scenario: Approval replay or argument mutation between drafting and execution
control_and_limit: Audit state checked, arguments revalidated; atomic binding and idempotency unverified.
remediation_and_verification: Bind canonical arguments, principal, action digest and expiry; test denial/replay.

scenario: Indirect prompt injection via workspace documents or model outputs
control_and_limit: Heuristic wrapping and recipient-risk helpers; no proof against adversarial content.
remediation_and_verification: Treat retrieved text as data; capability policy independent of model; adversarial fixtures.

scenario: Local subprocess treated as security sandbox; host-side callable executes before isolation
control_and_limit: Remote provider requests no egress and closes session; test profile explicitly unproven.
remediation_and_verification: Use least-privilege remote isolation; restrict host callables; test filesystem, egress and timeout.

scenario: Unsafe skill activation or poisoned learned procedure
control_and_limit: Promotion checks PASSED; separate activate path can move pointer to another version.
remediation_and_verification: Authorize activation separately, enforce eligible rollback versions; provenance and held-out tests.

scenario: Cache hit bypasses current memory and policy context
control_and_limit: Cache placed ahead of graph; exact scoping and invalidation not verified.
remediation_and_verification: Include tenant, policy, model and context versions in key; cross-tenant and stale-policy tests.

scenario: Memory poisoning, cross-user retrieval or stale preferences
control_and_limit: Typed recall and bounded result count; isolation and source trust unverified.
remediation_and_verification: Namespace records, preserve provenance, enforce promotion policy, test poisoning and deletion.

scenario: Telemetry captures sensitive requests and tool data
control_and_limit: Usage ledger and trajectories exist; redaction and retention unverified.
remediation_and_verification: Structured redaction, restricted access, retention and deletion tests.

scenario: Duplicate writes after restart or interruption
control_and_limit: Checkpoint graphs and approval rows; no executed restart proof in this review.
remediation_and_verification: Idempotency keys, transactional outbox, crash-injection tests around side effects.

scenario: MCP bearer token and error translation can expose information or insufficiently scope permissions
control_and_limit: Token configured; full auth and provider error handling not evaluated.
remediation_and_verification: Per-tool scopes, fail closed if missing token, redact errors and test direct server access.

scenario: Research evidence poisoning, runaway cost or publication without provenance
control_and_limit: Budget/reflection and evidence functions exist; performance/effectiveness unmeasured.
remediation_and_verification: Citation verification, budget fail-closed tests, source isolation, publication authorization.
